rawContent: As we come out of the March For Our Lives, I can’t really express the sadness I feel to see the murders of this man and Stephon Clark, and how little there is crossover between #EnoughIsEnough and #BlackLivesMatter in media and social media. https://t.co/5StjlisCbG

This is a big part of what people are talking about where the difference in response to #BLM and #MarchForOurLives is concerned. What would happen if the March For Our Lives faced this response? The ask is fundamentally the same: We don’t want to keep getting shot. https://t.co/0B9ipORpv9

The only difference is very simple, very straightforward, as someone else pointed out already. #MarchForOurLive is asking for state protection from private violence. #BLM is asking for protection from state violence.

Worthy thread, and much of what I’ve said regarding #BLM currently. Painting BLM as “extremist” is laughable, and the price that will be paid for ignoring them will mean organizations and groups that will be increasingly more extreme as time passes. https://t.co/RzvP1pMLJ9
